correctness.rationale: An exact complete-square identity holds for every zero-sum load and \(q=2^p\ge1\). Every remainder is a negative square with a positive coefficient. The sign of F is exactly the polynomial sign; its leading coefficient is positive, \(P(1)=-(m+n)<0\), and \(F(2)>0\). The unique critical null-vector, Gram rank, strictness, comparison with \(K_{m,n}\), and asymptotic follow algebraically. The separately constructed direct shortest-path quadratic checker replayed rational test cases, positive definite cases, explicit witnesses, and asymptotics.

Obata covers complete multipartite unsnowflaked QEC, whereas the nonmultipartite edge-added family \(m\ge3\) and its full p-range are not supplied there. value.rationale: The endpoint of negative type is an exact Hilbert-snowflake embeddability invariant. The perturbation of a classical biclique by one edge is canonical, turns the graph nonmultipartite, changes the extremizing load nonuniformly and improves the threshold strictly. The exact two-parameter cutoff, one-dimensional endpoint collapse, and sharp 1/m^2 gain provide a complete and quantitative stability law beyond routine evaluation at a single small graph.
